name: @globalcaos/cc-bridge
description: cc-bridge: one Claude login for your whole agent. Drives the real Claude Code CLI as a persistent per-session subprocess from OpenClaw/TinkerClaw, so every session uses your single `claude` login as a first-class streaming model provider (thinking + tools). Do NOT use together with harness-id: combining them may breach the terms of an Anthropic subscription. Review Anthropic's terms before distributing.
